text_en: For freedom Christ has set us free. Stand firm, therefore, and do not submit again to a yoke of slavery.
text_cn: 基督解救了我们，是为使我们获得自由；所以你们要站稳，不可再让奴隶的轭（è）束缚住你们。

text_en: Listen! I, Paul, am telling you that if you let yourselves be circumcised, Christ will be of no benefit to you.
text_cn: 请注意，我保禄告诉你们：若你们还愿意受割损，基督对你们就没有什么益处。

text_en: Once again I testify to every man who lets himself be circumcised that he is obliged to obey the entire law.
text_cn: 我再向任何自愿受割损的人声明：他有遵守全部法律的义务。

text_en: You who want to be justified by the law have cut yourselves off from Christ; you have fallen away from grace.
text_cn: 你们这些靠法律寻求成义的人，是与基督断绝了关系，由恩宠上跌了下来。

text_en: For through the Spirit, by faith, we eagerly wait for the hope of righteousness.
text_cn: 至于我们，我们却是依赖圣神，由于信德，怀着能成义的希望，

text_en: For in Christ Jesus neither circumcision nor uncircumcision counts for anything; the only thing that counts is faith working through love.
text_cn: 因为在基督耶稣内，割损或不割损都算不得什么，唯有以爱德行事的信德，才算什么。

text_en: You were running well; who prevented you from obeying the truth?
text_cn: 以前你们跑得好！有谁拦阻了你们去追随真理呢？

text_en: Such persuasion does not come from the one who calls you.
text_cn: 这种劝诱，决不是出自那召选你们的天主。

text_en: A little yeast leavens the whole batch of dough.
text_cn: 少许的酵母就能使整个面团发酵。

text_en: I am confident about you in the Lord that you will not think otherwise. But whoever it is that is confusing you will pay the penalty.
text_cn: 我在主内信任你们，认为你们不会有什么别的心思；但那扰乱你们的人，不论他是谁，必要承受惩罚。

text_en: But my friends, why am I still being persecuted if I am still preaching circumcision? In that case the offense of the cross has been removed.
text_cn: 至于我，弟兄们，如果我仍宣讲割损的需要，那我为什么还受迫害？若是这样，十字架的绊脚石就早已除去了。

text_en: I wish those who unsettle you would castrate themselves!
text_cn: 巴不得那些扰乱你们的人，将自己割净了！

text_en: For you were called to freedom, brothers and sisters; only do not use your freedom as an opportunity for self-indulgence, but through love become slaves to one another.
text_cn: 弟兄们，你们蒙召选，是为得到自由；但不要以这自由作为放纵肉欲的藉口，惟要以爱德彼此服事。

text_en: For the whole law is summed up in a single commandment, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself. ”
text_cn: 因为全部法律总括在这句话内：“爱你的近人如你自己”。

text_en: If, however, you bite and devour one another, take care that you are not consumed by one another.
text_cn: 但如果你们彼此相咬相吞，你们要小心，免得同归于尽。

text_en: Live by the Spirit, I say, and do not gratify the desires of the flesh.
text_cn: 我告诉你们：你们若随圣神的引导行事，就决不会去满足本性的私欲，

text_en: For what the flesh desires is opposed to the Spirit, and what the Spirit desires is opposed to the flesh; for these are opposed to each other, to prevent you from doing what you want.
text_cn: 因为本性的私欲相反圣神的引导，圣神的引导相反本性的私欲：二者互相敌对，致使你们不能行你们所愿意的事。

text_en: But if you are led by the Spirit, you are not subject to the law.
text_cn: 但如果你们随圣神的引导，就不在法律权下。

text_en: Now the works of the flesh are obvious: fornication, impurity, licentiousness,
text_cn: 本性私欲的作为是显而易见的：即淫乱、不洁、放荡、

text_en: idolatry, sorcery, enmities, strife, jealousy, anger, quarrels, dissensions, factions,
text_cn: 崇拜偶像、施行邪法、仇恨、竞争、嫉妒、忿怒、争吵、不睦、分党、

text_en: envy, drunkenness, carousing, and things like these. I am warning you, as I warned you before: those who do such things will not inherit the kingdom of God.
text_cn: 妒恨、【凶杀】、醉酒、宴乐，以及与这些相类似的事。我以前劝戒过你们，如今再说一次：做这种事的人，决不能承受天主的国。

text_en: By contrast, the fruit of the Spirit is love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, generosity, faithfulness,
text_cn: 然而圣神的效果却是：仁爱、喜乐、平安、忍耐、良善、温和、忠信、

text_en: gentleness, and self-control. There is no law against such things.
text_cn: 柔和、节制：关于这样的事，并没有法律禁止。

text_en: And those who belong to Christ Jesus have crucified the flesh with its passions and desires.
text_cn: 凡属于耶稣基督的人，已把肉身同邪情和私欲钉在十字架上了。

text_en: If we live by the Spirit, let us also be guided by the Spirit.
text_cn: 如果我们因圣神生活，就应随从圣神的引导而行事。

text_en: Let us not become conceited, competing against one another, envying one another.
text_cn: 不要贪图虚荣，不要彼此挑拨，互相嫉妒。
